listing.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe / MK8-online (Vnnc1)
listing.summary: Experimental static recompilation of Mario Kart 8 Deluxe 4.0.1 for Windows x64 and Linux amd64. Native Vulkan runtime, Mii creator, online play via Nextendo and Steam rooms. Bring your own game files and keys: no ROMs, assets or keys included.
